conversations.description: Optional inbox rows. A row may supply messages for client-side selection or href for server navigation.

participantIds.description: Member IDs for this conversation. The current user is omitted from the inbox avatar cluster when present.

isGroup.description: Keep group inbox treatment even when only one other member remains. Multiple other members also imply a group.

avatarProps.description: Optional group Avatar, such as an icon or image, in place of member avatars.

previewSenderId.description: Optional sender ID prefixed to a group conversation preview. Useful when only inbox summaries are loaded.

unreadCount.description: Unread message count shown with Tag.

firstUnreadMessageId.description: Stable ID of the first unread message in this conversation's supplied history. Required for an accurate unread divider.

context.description: Optional subject of this conversation, using the same fields as Chat.context. Its title appears in the inbox and its details above the transcript.

messages.description: History to show when this conversation is selected.

olderHistory.description: Optional older-page state for this conversation, using the same fields as Chat.olderHistory.

allowAttachments.description: Override whether this conversation accepts new file uploads.

actions.description: Optional host-defined directory actions. Omit or pass [] to hide the menu. Actions dispatch usx:chat-directory-action; the host controls availability and effects.

contacts.description: Optional people available for a new conversation.

href.description: Optional server-rendered contact URL in a non-selectable ChatDirectory. The new-message picker selects recipients instead of following contact links.

allowAttachments.description: Override whether a new conversation with this contact accepts uploads.

actions.description: Optional host-defined directory actions. Omit or pass [] to hide the menu. Actions dispatch usx:chat-directory-action; the host controls availability and effects.

participants.description: Participants, including the current user, agents, and bots. Message sender IDs should match participant IDs.

name.description: Visible sender name and transcript label.

avatarProps.description: Avatar props. Chat renders avatars without links.

presence.description: Optional current presence in inbox and contact lists. The host must keep it current; it is not a response-time promise.

currentUserId.description: Participant ID whose messages align to the outgoing side.

recipientIds.description: Initially selected participant IDs in the new-message recipient picker.

id.description: Unique prefix for directory action menus. Supply a distinct value for each directory on a page.

selectable.description: Render contacts as multi-select recipient rows using USX/USWDS Checkbox classes, with an Avatar inside each label, instead of navigation links or buttons.

formId.description: Composer form ID associated with the recipient checkboxes, usually <chat-id>-composer.
